decisions.reason: The document-use and suggestion-mode instructions concern the current question-set review; they do not change the required answer layers or their structure.
The source governs review and editing of the existing question set, not the content, format, or length of the new pre-interview chapter.
The existing-book review workflow does not change the separately required first-time leader questions chapter.
The source does not discuss or alter the AI interview-preparation chapter's inclusion, coverage, format, or length.
The editing instructions for reviewing existing questions do not alter the new chapter containing questions candidates can ask interviewers.
The source concerns curation of the existing edition and does not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
Using the Google Doc and suggestion mode for curation does not change the required global perspective or its integration into book content.
Although removing and adding questions may affect eventual word usage, the source establishes no new word-count value or budget rule.
The pre-project writing test was a separate candidate-assessment deliverable and is unaffected by the later manuscript-review workflow.
The source supplies materials and editing instructions but does not change any delivery date, duration, milestone order, or timeline condition.
